Use case: production transparent game VFX sprite sheet for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a 2D side-scrolling dark fantasy game. The reference supplies STYLE AND MATERIAL only: draw ONLY the effect, never the character, body silhouette, weapon prop or scenery.
